thesis: The podcast argues that Block executed a roughly 40% workforce reduction because foundational AI models fundamentally broke the historical correlation between headcount and output, allowing small squads to achieve 10 to 100x productivity gains. The restructuring was driven by a paradigm shift in late 2024 where tools became capable of working with complex existing codebases, leading to massive cuts on the development side while leaving outbound sales and compliance teams largely untouched.
